quick_skim.title: Balancing Generality and Specialization: A Survey on AI Datacenter Hardware Architecture
quick_skim.abstract: Rapidly growing AI workloads are driving large investments in AI datacenters. This survey classifies industrial AI accelerators into four architectural categories and compares their compute and memory organizations. It examines how node-, rack-, and pod-scale interconnects support collective communication, and traces architectural evolution across accelerator generations. The analysis connects advances in arithmetic throughput with changes in precision, data delivery, execution coordination, communication, power delivery, and cooling. It also discusses future design challenges arising from workload diversity, data movement, infrastructure constraints, and model evolution, showing how the trade-off between generality and specialization extends from individual accelerators to datacenter-scale systems. GitHub: github.com/Yufeng98/AI-datacenter

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 论文针对AI工作负载快速增长、数据中心硬件投资激增而架构演进缺乏系统梳理的问题，对工业界AI加速器进行综述。作者将加速器划分为四类架构，比较其计算与存储组织，并分析节点、机架与集群级互连如何支撑集合通信，追踪跨代演进。分析揭示了算力提升与精度、数据交付、执行协同、通信、供电和散热之间的关联，并指出通用性与专用性的权衡及未来设计挑战，为AI加速器与互连架构研究提供参考框架。

quick_skim.title: Tetris: Circuit Scheduling for Rearrangeably Non-Blocking Photonic Interconnects
quick_skim.abstract: Reconfigurable photonic interconnects are emerging as a promising communication architecture for next-generation distributed computing. Yet, most circuit schedulers are designed around an idealized view of the interconnect as either blocking or strictly non-blocking. Practical scalable designs are often rearrangeably non-blocking (RNB), with connections routed through networks of internal $2\times2$ switches. This changes the scheduling problem fundamentally: establishing a new connection can force existing connections to be rerouted, trigger state changes across multiple internal switches, and impose reconfiguration delay on otherwise unrelated traffic.   We present Tetris, a circuit scheduling algorithm for RNB photonic interconnects. Tetris builds on two observations. First, All-to-All demands are often not doubly stochastic, leaving a small number of endpoints as communication bottlenecks. Second, reconfiguration delay can be large enough to change which connection should be scheduled next. Tetris prioritizes bottleneck endpoints using their remaining communication and reconfiguration work, while selecting and routing matchings to preserve ongoing connections whenever possible. Matchings ensure progress, but connections are scheduled independently, allowing completed connections to be replaced without matching-wide barriers and incurring delay only at switches whose states change. Our simulation and hardware-emulation results show that Tetris reduces All-to-All demand completion time by up to $6.6$x over Birkhoff--von Neumann-based scheduling and by $30$% over Sunflow. More broadly, RNB interconnects raise new questions in multi-tenant scheduling and routing for partial reconfiguration, which we discuss at the end of the paper.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Reconfigurable photonic interconnects are promising but most circuit schedulers assume idealized blocking or strictly non-blocking models. Tetris proposes a scheduling algorithm for rearrangeably non-blocking interconnects that handles rerouting and switch reconfiguration delay for scalable photonic networks.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 可重构光子互连是下一代分布式计算的重要通信架构，但现有电路调度器多基于阻塞或严格无阻塞的理想模型，忽略了实际可重构无阻塞(RNB)网络中重路由与状态变更带来的延迟。本文提出Tetris电路调度算法，针对RNB光子互连中连接建立会迫使已有连接重路由的问题进行调度优化。结果表明该算法能有效处理内部2×2开关网络的状态变化并降低重配置开销，为可扩展光子互连调度提供了实用方案。
